Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]This mod replaces all standart Haley's dialogues to be more horny, edgy and flirty. Haley is a big futanari girl with huge... assets down there and up here. She is open about her abnormal anatomy and will constantly remind you of it!

[b]Main features[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Haley have a quite big assets now and it's hard not to notice! (Well, not visual, but descriptively... use your imagination!)[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Haley's character is mostly her usual self, but now she like to spend some time watching adult stuff and annoy you about it.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Lots of flirt, sexual and weird humor and even some pop culture references. There is even some wholesome lines about Emily, because Emily deserves some love too![/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Covers more that 90% of Haley dialogue lines, including events![/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]She will have a special reaction to some gift items! Only 1 now, but will add more soon. Maybe even change her available gift list completely.
Because for now there's no way to learn which items are special, here's the list of items to which she will have a special reaction (it is a spoiler, ofc):[/size]
[/color]
[spoiler][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]melon, pumpkin, eggplant, banana, spice berry, pineapple, hot pepper. also changed reaction to: cococnut, stardrop tea. THE LIST AND REACTION MIGHT BE CHANGED IN THE FUTURE![/size][/color][/spoiler]
[/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]No sprites or portrait changes in near future (I am not an artist, and I don't want to use AI). Any suggestion and help with it are very much welcome![/size][/color][/*]

Why?
[/b]I made this for fun on my free time, because using Content Patcher for modding turned out to be so easy and I wanted to give it a try!
TL;DR: For the love of the game.

[b]Quick Q&A:[/b]
Q: Will I add other girls?
A: In this mod only Haley [s]and someone else[/s] are considered futanari. But if this weird-ahh mod will get some attention, I might consider making something bigger...
So, please, leave some comments or endorsments if you like this!

Q: Any compatability patches for other mods?
A: Maybe! Depends on the amount of requests and what will other mod makers would say.
From 0.6 onward the mod is also i18n compatible![/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Install SMAPI. 
Download Content Patcher and this mod.
Unpack them in Mods folder in your game directory.
Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI launcher.
You're amazing![/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Only SMAPI and Content Patcher.
[b]
Compatability[/b]
Non compatible with any mods that change or affect base game Haley dialogues.
Compatible with anything else.[/size][/color]
